title: Get Involved
description: Attend a workshop, volunteer, or collaborate with Bay Area Youth Conservation.

header.heading: Want to help out?
header.body: You do not need experience or a long-term commitment. Pick whichever fits, and reach out.

cards.heading: Attend a workshop
cards.body: Join the workshop series at San Leandro Library for climate education

cards.heading: Volunteer with us
cards.body: Participate in local environmental remediation with us

cards.heading: Collaborate
cards.body: We work with schools, clubs, libraries, and local groups to bring youth conservation projects and education to more people.

collaboration.heading: Bring youth conservation education to your community space.
collaboration.body: Bay Area Youth Conservation is open to local collaborations, workshop ideas, volunteer projects, and education partnerships across the San Leandro and San Lorenzo area.
